CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: fix(mud): Hi-Potion/Potion/Ether/Echo Drop/Antidote now have real effects via 'use' -- cmdUseItem previously reported 'nothing happens yet' for every consumable; Echo Drop was already implemented but only reachable via removedebuffs/erase, not use. Also fixed use/eat's dispatch never lowercasing item-id args. GitHub-reported: 'the mud items arent implemented like echo drops and hi potion.' (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
